name: Ahlam Mallak
title: Research & Development | Data Scientist | Machine Learning & AI | Real-Time Data & Industry 4.0 | Biomedical Data Analytics | Computational bioinformatics
education: PhD of Computer and Electrical Engineering, Siegen University
bio: I’m a scientist–engineer who enjoys finding patterns, asking questions and turning complex data into useful ideas. My work spans machine learning, real-time sensor systems, Industry 4.0 and biomedical data analytics.
aboutLong: My path through research and engineering has taken me across Europe, the Middle East and South Korea, connecting different disciplines through a shared interest in what we can learn—and build—with data. I hold a PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering and bring over 10 years of experience in machine learning, real-time data analysis and large-scale data systems. I have developed data-driven solutions in academic and industry-oriented research, from detecting faults in industrial machinery to investigating biomedical data and computational bioinformatics. My experience includes data integration, statistical modeling, deep learning and scalable analytical workflows. What I enjoy most is the research itself: exploring a question, experimenting with approaches and developing something useful from the results. I’m particularly drawn to work that combines scientific curiosity with practical invention.
